_about: Files under public/images that have an R2 manifest entry but MUST stay deployed on Vercel, because a rendered page requests them at their origin path. Checked by the deploy layer of scripts/check-r2-coverage.mjs --rendered (postbuild): every other R2 original must be excluded by .vercelignore, and every entry here must still be requested at origin by a prerendered page, or the build fails. One entry per path, each with a reason. Added 2026-10-23 (t_e1d348db).

entries.reason: Tapestry Talk episode 1 video poster. <video poster> on /news/georgia-tapestry-talk (blog-post-content.tsx) and /tapestries/georgia (tapestry-talk-section.tsx) takes post.image as a raw origin path; the R2 loader never sees it. Excluding it would 404 the poster. Can be excluded once both components pass the poster through the R2 loader.

The markdown says /images/news/images/van-schaick-mansion.webp; the redundant-segment fix turns it into this path, and the rendered requests it at origin, not R2. Excluding it would 404 the figure. Can be excluded once markdown.ts sends this figure to its R2 variant.
